title: Reviews
description: What patients wrote after their visit

help.title: About reviews
help.overview: A patient can leave one review from the link in their appointment email once the visit is completed. It stays hidden until you publish it; published reviews show on your clinic's site and as stars on the portal.

sections.title: On this page
items: Publish a review to show it on your site and the portal.
An appointment can have only one review.
A review shows the patient's first name and the initial of their last name.
